evidence.notes: Java-style escapes round-trip controls, quotes, backslash, slash, BMP, and supplementary code points.
EcmaScript escaping additionally escapes slash and round-trips supplementary code points.
Control, BMP, and supplementary code points escape as UTF-16 Unicode sequences.
Java-style escaped controls, octal, quote, slash, and UTF-16 Unicode sequences decode through the local decoder.
EcmaScript-style escaped slash and UTF-16 Unicode sequences decode through the local decoder.
UTF-16 Unicode escape sequences, including surrogate pairs, decode to the original value.
Supplementary code points use Apex UTF-16 code-unit indexes.
Supplementary code points return their UTF-16 code units.
One- and two-argument Apache-style abbreviation edge forms are pinned.
Overlay clamps out-of-range indexes and swaps reversed bounds.
Rune case swapping leaves non-letters unchanged.
